integrity: Proof and exact rational verification are included; finite enumeration is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The all-moment order is not a stochastic order of solution counts and does not imply finite-sample satisfiability-probability monotonicity.
The theorem requires independent clauses sampled with replacement and a balanced clause-wide fair sign coin.
Historical priority and independent audit have not been established.
title: All-order moment dominance under polarisation in random \(k\)-SAT
